envelope.types: single-disk ordinary ZIP; regular files and directories only; no links, ZIP64, encryption, flags, comments or extra fields

authority.bootstrap: Resolve the recorded location without parsing a kit manifest or native journal; select the reviewed updater release; verify transport hashes, archive structure, updater inventory and protocol; hand off once.
authority.updater: Interpret installed/current kit formats, select and verify the application archive, perform native update and recovery, independently confirm completion, and own the outcome.
authority.observation: Progress never acknowledges completion or grants installation authority. TUI observes the fresh process through the bounded progress protocol.
authority.desktop: exec preserves the helper PID and original Monitor parent. The downloaded updater launches its own progress viewer, then reopens Monitor after its viewer exits.
authority.offlineResult: Use the verified updater referenced by an unresolved saved outcome; if that temporary directory is absent, use the verified bundled updater. A substituted directory or symlink is refused, and read-only status preserves the saved outcome. No release fetch is needed for status or acknowledgement.

stableLocators.installation: .shin-installation.json retains prefix, prefix_identity, home and home_identity for protocol 1. Unknown fields and the native journal format are outside the bootstrap contract.
stableLocators.unresolvedUpdater: The bounded private JSON object at <home>/updates/state.json retains an optional updater locator. Bootstrap ignores every other outcome field; future engines must preserve this locator projection independently of their journals.

retention.preserve: Retain the immutable verified updater when the native saved outcome references it. Failed review or changed identity preserves artifacts.
retention.cleanup: Read-only probes never delete the envelope. The applying updater removes its temporary envelope after confirmed success, verified acknowledgement or a refusal before it owns a saved outcome.

recoveryEntry: The independently downloaded versioned install.sh fetches the new complete kit and launches its own shin-updater install-local. It needs no functioning installed launcher; the fresh kit owns installation and journal recovery.

markerGeneratorTransition.authorization: Applying a qualified kit update authorizes only engine.generatorIdentity migration from a known retired generator on an already approved managed route. It grants no enrollment, profile, source-scope, limit or quality-policy changes.
markerGeneratorTransition.transaction: Journal the original and target marker bytes before replacement; preserve formatting and all other bytes; approve the exact target hash through native marker-accept before normal rebuild and qualification.
markerGeneratorTransition.rollback: Restore original bytes and exact approval through the verified previous CLI before restarting the old service. Interrupted writes and approvals resume from the same private journal.
markerGeneratorTransition.refusals: Preserve pending owner edits, changed grant tokens or route identities, symlinks, unsafe files, ambiguous generator fields and unknown generators for review. Never infer approval from current marker bytes alone.

publication: The guarded publisher requires the exact qualified kit, separate updater, both checksums and installer. Updater bytes must match the updater inventory embedded in that exact kit.
previewTrust: GitHub HTTPS plus GitHub asset digest and SHA-256 checksum. No independent publisher signature or Developer ID/notarization is claimed.
